info.title: OMA LwM2M Robot Service Info (Object ID 10331)

Robot_Service_Info.label: Robot Service Info
Robot_Service_Info.description: This LWM2M Object includes robot service related information.

Current_status.label: Current status
Current_status.description: Current status, for example: working, pasued, dormant, holding, charging and so on.

Services_Providing.label: Services Providing
Services_Providing.description:
Providing services: for example: patrolling, advertisement playing, patrolling and so on,
			one robot can do several works at the same time, for example, patrolling with advertisement playing.

Advertising_Contents.label: Advertising Contents
Advertising_Contents.description: The Advertising Contents it is playing.

Current_Language.label: Current Language
Current_Language.description: Current language used by the robot.

Moving_Speed.label: Moving Speed
Moving_Speed.description: The moving speed of the robot.

Location.label: Location
Location.description: Contains the reference to the location object(6).

Map_List.label: Map List
Map_List.description: Assigned Map List and the Map currently within.

Planned_Route_list.label: Planned Route list
Planned_Route_list.description: Planned Route list, routes are separated by comma.

Route_to-do_List.label: Route to-do List
Route_to-do_List.description: Routes to be done, routes are separated by comma.

Synchronous_Whistle.label: Synchronous Whistle
Synchronous_Whistle.description: The status of the Synchronous Whistle, 1:On, 0:Off.

TTS_Speaker.label: TTS Speaker
TTS_Speaker.description: Which speaker of the vender is selected.
